queries: In Arabidopsis, which enzymes are responsible for the maintenance of CG, CHG, and CHH methylation contexts, respectively, and what siRNAs guide de novo methylation in the RdDM pathway?

candidates.text: In plants, DNA methylation occurs in three sequence contexts: CG, CHG, and CHH (with H representing A, T, or C), and two key methylation mechanisms are recognized: de novo methylation and maintenance methylation. In Arabidopsis, de novo DNA methylation is mediated by the RNA-directed DNA methylation (RdDM) pathway, while the maintenance of CG, CHG, and CHH methylation is governed by distinct enzymes: DNA methyltransferase 1 (MET1) for CG, chromomethylase 3 (CMT3) for CHG, and both RdDM and chromomethylase 2 (CMT2) for CHH methylation (Matzke and Mosher 2014). In the RdDM pathway, 24-nt siRNAs direct de novo cytosine methylation, with domains rearranged methylase 2 (DRM2) carrying out methylation across all sequence contexts (Matzke and Mosher 2014). In autotetraploid rice, increased siRNA abundance has been linked to CHG and CHH hypermethylation of class II transposable elements (TEs), subsequently reducing the expression of nearby genes (Zhang et al. 2015). DNA methylation levels are regulated by dynamic methylation and demethylation processes, which influence key molecular pathways in plant development (Finnegan et al. 2000), viral immunity (Pooggin 2013), gene imprinting (Li et

In the cytoplasm, they are mainly incorporated into AGO4 containing complexes and imported back to the nucleus to target nascent transcripts transcribed by Pol V at the same loci, leading to DNA methylation. Gene silencing also involves chromatin remodelation, typically through methylation of histone H3. The role of SHH1 in A. thaliana is to recognize H3K9me2 (dimethylation of lysine 9 in histone H3), which recruits Pol IV and initiates siRNA biogenesis for the maintenance of gene silencing. Epigenetic regulation may induce initiation of NPE Genes associated with chromatin assembly and methylation of histone H3-K9 were enriched among the DEGs in apomictic cells, which indicates that a reprogramming of chromatin occurs during the initiation of NPE. The reprogramming of chromatin occurs during the somatic-to-reproductive cell fate transition in plants. The DNA methylation pathway is critical for distinguishing apomictic from sexual reproduction. Indeed, loss of methyltransferase and RdDM function down-regulates an ovule-specific chromatin-based silencing pathway and leads to apomictic reproduction. In citrus apomictic cells, global CHH methylation levels were decreased. In NEI cells, the CHH hypo-methylation of DNA was prominent, especially in retrotransposons. The expression of two DNA methyltransferase genes and four RdDM pathway genes was down-regulated in NEI cells. Among these genes, DECREASE IN DNA METHYLATION 1 (DDM1) is involved in the maintenance of methylation at both CG and non-CG sites in Arabidopsis. answer: 在拟南芥中，CG、CHG和CHH三种序列背景的DNA甲基化维持分别由不同的酶负责：CG甲基化由DNA甲基转移酶1（MET1）维持，CHG甲基化由chromomethylase 3（CMT3）维持，而CHH甲基化则由RdDM途径和chromomethylase 2（CMT2）共同维持[1]。RdDM途径通过24-nt siRNA引导从头胞嘧啶甲基化，其中domains rearranged methylase 2（DRM2）负责在所有序列背景下执行甲基化[1]。因此，24-nt siRNA是RdDM途径中引导从头甲基化的关键分子[1]。

question_en: Which enzymes maintain CG, CHG and CHH methylation in Arabidopsis, respectively, and which siRNAs direct de novo methylation in the RdDM pathway?
